scope: Phase 10D physical discovery of real vertical Quartz wheel delivery to a test-owned AppKit scroll fixture before any public raw-wheel API is frozen

successEvidence.negativeDelivery: ProbeScrollView observes at least one scrollWheel event after wheel1=-3
successEvidence.negativeConsequence: documentVisibleRect origin changes from an interior baseline
successEvidence.positiveDelivery: ProbeScrollView observes at least one scrollWheel event after wheel1=+3
successEvidence.positiveConsequence: documentVisibleRect origin changes after exact baseline reset
successEvidence.signMapping: the two signs produce opposite qualitative content directions
successEvidence.restoration: original pointer and previous frontmost application are restored
successEvidence.privacy: fixture coordinates, numeric scroll offsets and native display identifiers are not persisted

resultPolicy.BLOCKED: The macOS/Swift/Accessibility environment prevents the controlled fixture from compiling or executing.
resultPolicy.FAIL: Delivery, real scroll consequence, opposite-sign mapping, baseline reset, restoration, privacy or semantic-boundary invariants fail.
resultPolicy.PASS: Both raw wheel signs are physically delivered to the test-owned AppKit scroll fixture, independently change scroll state in opposite directions, and cleanup succeeds without creating a public API.

nextStepOnPass: Use physical sign/delivery evidence to freeze a narrow public raw-wheel contract while keeping semantic ui.scroll preferred, then validate that public API separately.
nextStepOnBlockedOrFail: Preserve immutable evidence, diagnose forward, and do not add or promote a raw-wheel public capability.
